services.name: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry
services.description: Servicio de telemetría de Windows. Desactivar mejora privacidad pero puede afectar diagnósticos.
services.safetyNote: Telemetry service. Disabling improves privacy but can affect diagnostics and some enterprise features.

services.name: WAP Push Message Routing Service
services.description: Enrutador de mensajes WAP push. Seguro de desactivar.
services.safetyNote: Legacy WAP push router. Safe to disable on personal PCs.

services.name: Downloaded Maps Manager
services.description: Gestor de mapas descargados. Seguro si no usas mapas offline.
services.safetyNote: Only needed for offline Maps. Safe to disable if you don't use it.

services.name: Retail Demo Service
services.description: Servicio de demo de tiendas. Seguro de desactivar en PCs personales.
services.safetyNote: Retail display-only service. Safe to disable on personal PCs.

services.name: SysMain (Superfetch)
services.description: Precarga apps frecuentes. En SSD modernos puede no ser necesario.
services.safetyNote: Preload helps on HDD systems; on SSDs disabling it may hurt app launch times. Reversible.

services.name: Windows Search
services.description: Indexación de búsqueda. Desactivar afecta gravemente la búsqueda en Start.
services.safetyNote: Windows Search indexing. Disabling degrades Start menu and File Explorer search.

services.name: Xbox Live Auth Manager
services.description: Autenticación de Xbox Live. Seguro si no usas Xbox Live.
services.safetyNote: Xbox Live authentication. Safe to disable if you don't use Xbox Live.

services.name: Xbox Live Game Save
services.description: Guardado en la nube de Xbox Live. Seguro si no usas Xbox Live.
services.safetyNote: Xbox Live cloud saves. Safe to disable if you don't use Xbox Live.
